description:

- System prompt as inline message (developer vs system role per compat)
- User messages (text + base64 image_url parts)

- Tool definitions (function type, strict mode per compat)
- Param injection: reasoning_effort / enable_thinking / reasoning:{effort} per thinking_format; store; stream_options; max_tokens field selection
- Tool-call ID normalization (pipe-split, truncation)
